title: Kruskal Spanning Forest
statement:
Use Kruskal’s algorithm and DSU to find a minimum-weight spanning tree within every connected component.

Input
n m, then m undirected edges u v w.

Output
Print total forest weight and the number of connected components.

Constraints
1 ≤ n ≤ 200000, 0 ≤ m ≤ 200000. Endpoints are in [1,n]. Parallel edges and self-loops are allowed. Weights have absolute value at most 10⁹.
